quantity.name: compressive strength
quantity.definition: peak stress in unconfined compression at 1 mm/s

source.authors: Weber M, Rothschild MA, Niehoff A
source.sample: costal cartilage midsubstance (no perichondrium) from ribs 1-10 of 12 cadavers (forensic + body donor); unconfined compression 198 cylinders from 10 cadavers; indentation on 12

protocol.summary: Unconfined compression: cylinders 6 mm diameter, L=5.9+-0.7 mm, cut dorsoventral or mediolateral, stored -20 C in 0.9% NaCl gauze and immersed in saline before testing; preload 0.1 N at 0.05 mm/s; compression at 1.0 mm/s to failure; E_C = slope of linear part.
how_to_simulate: Model a 6 mm diameter, 5.9 mm long cartilage cylinder between frictionless/rigid platens
Compress at 1 mm/s; report slope of linear region (E_C) and peak stress

extraction.check_notes: Results text, mean +- SD (data not normally distributed; per-body median/IQR in Table 2 not extracted). doi printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
